---
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  version: 1.0.0
  title: allOf scalar $ref example generation (issue #2357)
paths:
  "/foo":
    get:
      operationId: getFoo
      summary: Returns foo, whose baz property is allOf a single string $ref
      responses:
        '200':
          description: a foo
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/foo'
  "/baz":
    get:
      operationId: getBaz
      summary: Returns a top-level allOf a single string $ref
      responses:
        '200':
          description: a bare string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                allOf:
                  - $ref: '#/components/schemas/bar'
components:
  schemas:
    bar:
      type: string
      example: "hello"
    foo:
      type: object
      properties:
        baz:
          allOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/bar'
